recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It preserves the historical FHIR-12375 application while removing the last discovered stale Linked Data label after the later Exchange-module rework.
issue_request: FHIR-12375 was Published/Persuasive and asked to rename the misleading FHIR Ontology Module page to FHIR Linked Data Module, change ontology-module.html to linked-data-module.html, and make RDF/Ontology more visible from the module box.
initial_application: The request was applied by dbooth in SVN rev 10249, represented in git by 259c11d220c00539906b4d89f3590a7f279d78a0, which renamed source/ontology-module.html to source/linked-data-module.html and updated hierarchy, module fragment, module list, and module text sources.
additional_context: The original Zulip thread confirms Linked Data was chosen because the page covered RDF-related material beyond ontology. Later commit c397bd0b1f4c760dd227af300eaa8044b9e968a3 reworked the Linked Data module into the broader Exchange module, deleted linked-data-module.html, added exchange-module.html, and updated hierarchy and module diagram entries to Exchange. Current source no longer has ontology-module.html or linked-data-module.html.
reconciliation: Changed source/modules-list.html so the build-scoped overview include labels exchange-module.html as Exchange, matching source/exchange-module.html, source/modules-fragment.html, and source/foundation-module.html.
source_changes: source/modules-list.html: changed the exchange-module.html link text from Linked Data to Exchange.

related_jiras.note: A separate Published ontology TODO issue noted the Linked Data rename in comments, but it concerned separate ontology page cleanup and was not independently decided here.
